review.images: The three villa scenes are from the dedicated villa section on physical pages 22–24 of Sobha’s Coral brochure. Page 28 is a qualified island overview. Adjacent mansion and apartment imagery was excluded.
review.location: The plot and type legend are visible on physical page 30. Sobha’s official Siniya Island page supplies the map link and approximate time from Dubai. The distance rings on page 27 are map context rather than route distances.
review.floorPlans: All 12 full source sheets for four variants and three levels were checked. The Type B mirror ground sheet (page 44) prints a higher maximum plot area than its first and terrace sheets (pages 45–46). The stable whole-villa saleable total is kept separate.

unavailable: Coral-specific interior imagery, villa entrance coordinates, exact road distances and completed-property photographs were unavailable in the reviewed material.
